title: CA presentation deck clips, 16 November 2026
method: Real UI driven by Playwright; only the clip segment recorded with the Chrome DevTools screencast (JPEG q92, every frame timestamped); rebuilt at constant 30 fps from those timestamps, so playback is real time. No source edits, state injection, CSS hiding, overlays or speed changes. Headless Chromium draws no mouse cursor.

fieldNotes.atSeconds: Time inside the delivered clip, from its first frame. Actions are logged when the input was sent; observations are DOM reads made just after.
fieldNotes.footerFrame: The footer frame counter as rendered (e.g. FRAME 12 / 21, or NO RUN).
fieldNotes.status: The Status panel sentence; statusPath is the hovered path line when there is one.
fieldNotes.notes: Step-note text in the DOM with the computed opacity of its positioned element at that instant. A note fades in just after a forward step and is gone by about 1.6 s; opacity 0 at a clip start is a note left from before the clip, already invisible. The posters were taken while the note was fully shown.
fieldNotes.canvasViewport: The React Flow viewport transform; unchanged values mean the drawing did not move or zoom.
